cmd: ls -la && echo "---RUN-ENV---" && cat .run-env 2>/dev/null && echo "---MAKEFILE---" && cat Makefile 2>/dev/null
echo "===SCRIPTS===" && ls scripts && echo "---up.sh---" && cat scripts/up.sh && echo "---down.sh---" && cat scripts/down.sh && echo "===DOCS===" && ls -R docs | head -50

echo "===FULL TREE (excluding target/.git)==="
find api edge lists items notifications -type f -not -path '*/target/*' | sort
echo ""
echo "===ACCEPTANCE TESTS TREE==="
find acceptance-tests -type f | sort

cd /Users/ggalazzo/workspace/personal/recq-rigor-study/runs/todolist__arm_a_evento__claude-opus__t1__rep1__20260616T073234Z/workspace
for svc in edge lists items notifications; do echo "=== $svc/application.properties ==="; cat $svc/src/main/resources/application.properties; echo; done
echo "=== App classes ==="
cat edge/src/main/java/com/study/app/EdgeApp.java
cat lists/src/main/java/com/study/app/ListsApp.java
echo "=== edge EventoConfiguration ==="
cat edge/src/main/java/com/study/app/config/EventoConfiguration.java
echo "=== items pom ==="
cat items/pom.xml; cat notifications/pom.xml

cd ~/.m2/repository 2>/dev/null && find . -path '*eventoframework*' -name '*.jar' 2>/dev/null | grep -v sources | grep -v javadoc | head -20
echo "---if empty, maven not yet resolved; check evento-bundle---"
ls ~/.m2/repository/com/eventoframework/evento-bundle/ 2>/dev/null

cd /tmp && rm -rf eventojar && mkdir eventojar && cd eventojar
unzip -oq ~/.m2/repository/com/eventoframework/evento-bundle/2.1.3/evento-bundle-2.1.3.jar -d bundle
unzip -oq ~/.m2/repository/com/eventoframework/evento-common/2.1.3/evento-common-2.1.3.jar -d common
echo "=== bundle reference classes (aggregate/command handling) ==="
find bundle -name '*.class' | grep -iE 'aggregate|reference|invoc|lock' | head -40

cd /tmp/eventojar
which javap >/dev/null && echo "javap ok"
echo "=== AggregateManager ==="
javap -p -c bundle/com/evento/application/manager/AggregateManager.class 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'null|Event|lock|aggregateId|throw|invoke' | head -60

cd /tmp/eventojar
echo "=== AggregateReference (invoke) ==="
javap -p -c bundle/com/evento/application/reference/AggregateReference.class 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'invoke|null|Event|DomainEvent|aggregateLifecycle|throw|require' | head -50
echo ""
echo "=== DomainCommandResponseMessage ctor/fields ==="
javap -p common/com/evento/common/modeling/messaging/message/application/DomainCommandResponseMessage.class 2>/dev/null

cd /tmp/eventojar
echo "=== AggregateManager all methods (signatures) ==="
javap -p bundle/com/evento/application/manager/AggregateManager.class 2>/dev/null
echo ""
echo "=== lambda body searching for null-event handling / requireNonNull / store ==="
javap -p -c bundle/com/evento/application/manager/AggregateManager.class 2>/dev/null | sed -n '/lambda/,$p' | grep -iE 'null|Event|requireNonNull|IllegalState|setDomainEvent|new #|throw|orElse' | head -60

cd /tmp/eventojar
echo "=== DomainEventMessage ctor ==="
javap -p -c common/com/evento/common/modeling/messaging/message/application/DomainEventMessage.class 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,60p' | grep -iE 'DomainEventMessage|getEventName|getPayloadName|getType|null|requireNonNull|getClass' | head
echo ""
echo "=== PayloadMessage / superclass getEventName ==="
javap -p common/com/evento/common/modeling/messaging/message/application/DomainEventMessage.class 2>/dev/null
echo "=== check parent Message classes ==="
find common -name 'PayloadEventMessage*' -o -name 'EventMessage*' | head

cd /tmp/eventojar
echo "=== EventMessage ctor (does it NPE/requireNonNull on payload?) ==="
javap -p -c common/com/evento/common/modeling/messaging/message/application/EventMessage.class 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'EventMessage|requireNonNull|getClass|null|getType|setPayload|getPayloadName' | head -30
echo ""
echo "=== Message base ctor ==="
find common -name 'Message.class' -path '*message*'
javap -p -c common/com/evento/common/modeling/messaging/message/application/Message.class 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'Message\(|requireNonNull|getClass|getPayloadName|null' | head -20

cd /tmp/eventojar
echo "=== grep for 'Application Started' across bundle classes ==="
grep -rl "Application Started" bundle 2>/dev/null
for f in $(grep -rl "Application Started" bundle 2>/dev/null); do echo "--- $f ---"; javap -p "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -5; done
echo ""
echo "=== EventoBundle.start / Builder methods ==="
javap -p bundle/com/evento/application/EventoBundle.class 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'start|getInvoker|isMinimumInstances|waitUntil' | head
echo ""
echo "=== where is 'Application Started' logged? find method context ==="
javap -p -c bundle/com/evento/application/EventoBundle.class 2>/dev/null | grep -iB2 -A2 "Application Started" | head -20

cd /tmp/eventojar
echo "=== strings search in all evento jars for 'Started' / readiness markers ==="
for j in ~/.m2/repository/com/eventoframework/evento-bundle/2.1.3/evento-bundle-2.1.3.jar ~/.m2/repository/com/eventoframework/evento-common/2.1.3/evento-common-2.1.3.jar; do
  echo "--- $j ---"
  unzip -p "$j" '*.class' 2>/dev/null | strings | grep -iE 'Application Started|head.?reached|Bundle.*regist|Started!' | sort -u | head
done
echo ""
echo "=== broader: grep class files for 'Started' literal ==="
grep -rao "Application Started[!A-Za-z ]*" bundle common 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head
grep -rao "Started[!A-Za-z ]*" bundle 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head

cd /tmp/eventojar
echo "=== EventoBundle\$Builder methods ==="
javap -p bundle/com/evento/application/EventoBundle\$Builder.class 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'start|Hook|consumer|head' | head
echo ""
echo "=== start() bytecode around 'Application Started' and head-reached/consumer waits ==="
javap -p -c bundle/com/evento/application/EventoBundle\$Builder.class 2>/dev/null | grep -inE 'Application Started|StartedHook|headReached|isHeadReached|waitUntilConsumerHead|consumer|RunnableHook|registr' | head -40

cd /tmp/eventojar
echo "=== tail of start() — find 'Application Started!' offset and what precedes (head wait?) ==="
javap -p -c bundle/com/evento/application/EventoBundle\$Builder.class 2>/dev/null | awk '/public com.evento.application.EventoBundle start/{f=1} f' | grep -nE 'Application Started|acquire|Semaphore|headReached|isHeadReached|await|StartedHook|onEventoStarted|join|Starting|consumer head|head' | head -40

cd /tmp/eventojar
echo "=== exception-related classes ==="
find common bundle -name '*.class' | grep -iE 'exception|error|throwable|ExceptionWrapper' | grep -v '\$' | head -40

cd /tmp/eventojar
echo "=== ExceptionWrapper ==="
javap -p common/com/evento/common/modeling/exceptions/ExceptionWrapper.class 2>/dev/null
echo ""
echo "=== ExceptionWrapper bytecode: how it reconstructs/throws (toException/throwException) ==="
javap -p -c common/com/evento/common/modeling/exceptions/ExceptionWrapper.class 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'getException|throw|forName|newInstance|getMessage|getThrowableClass|toThrowable|RuntimeException' | head -30
echo ""
echo "=== AggregateNotInitializedError hierarchy ==="
javap -p common/com/evento/common/modeling/exceptions/AggregateNotInitializedError.class 2>/dev/null | head -5

cd /tmp/eventojar
echo "=== classes referencing toException / completeExceptionally ==="
for f in $(find common bundle -name '*.class' | grep -v '\$'); do
  if javap -c "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'toException'; then echo "$f"; fi
done | head
echo ""
echo "=== AggregateNotInitializedError / AggregateInitializedError full ==="
javap -p common/com/evento/common/modeling/exceptions/AggregateInitializedError.class 2>/dev/null
echo "--- toException detail ---"
javap -p -c common/com/evento/common/modeling/exceptions/ExceptionWrapper.class 2>/dev/null | awk '/public java.lang.Exception toException/,/^$/' | grep -iE 'forName|newInstance|RuntimeException|getConstructor|String' | head
